headline: PCSX2 texture packs arrive as Going Commando gains save bonuses and fixes
summary: Development builds can use native PCSX2 PNG and DDS texture packs chosen per game version, with OpenRAC packs taking priority (#443). Older level exports may need regenerating to retain palette alpha. Going Commando now sees Ratchet & Clank saves for the Barlow vendor's free weapons (#447). Its Yeedil freeze and end-credits picture, trails and skip controls are also fixed (#445, #446).
highlights: Android's Games tab becomes a disc shelf with pad and touch navigation, while the desktop launcher and in-game menus gain a shared look (#454).
Large menu text gains smoother curves (#449), and HUD: Edges no longer exposes parked pause-menu panels as black boxes (#463).
#451 fills missing function bindings for Ratchet & Clank PAL v1 and NTSC-J. NTSC-U's overwrite-save prompt and two library bindings are repaired after the Lombyte update (#429, #461, #462).
Draw distance is unified across games, with a Kalebo dome-glass fix (#452). The title world's shrubs stay visible beneath the main menu at Original distance (#455).

Lossless LZ4 asset storage becomes the default (#441). Vulkan rendering checks reuse more work, and empty animated scenery no longer invalidates static shadow depth (#442). The shadow cache remains off by default.

Enhanced graphics presets (#453) and weapon-target hooks (#464) remain drafts. Gold-bolt accounting (#444), persistent mod settings (#460) and pause-menu stick fixes (#459) were proposed but have not merged.
